meta.name: cvs
meta.description: Rules for interacting with local version control and remote platforms (GitHub, GitLab, Forgejo) based on the CVS_TOOL environment variable.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 用自然语言管理代码版本和远程仓库
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常用 Git 和 GitHub 但想省去命令行操作
copy.tagline_en: Manage code versions and remote repos with natural language
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often use Git and GitHub but want to skip command-line operations

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会根据环境变量 CVS_TOOL 的值，使用对应的本地版本控制工具（如 git 或 jj）和远程平台工具（如 gh、glab 或 MCP 工具）来管理代码、处理 Issue 和 PR。
howto.when: 当 Claude 需要执行版本控制操作（如提交、推送、创建 Issue 或 PR）时触发。

say.text: 帮我创建一个新的 GitHub Issue，标题是‘修复登录页的样式问题’。
把当前分支的修改提交并推送到远程仓库。
say.note: Claude 会使用 git 或 jj 执行本地提交和推送。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude uses the local version control tool (e.g., git or jj) and remote platform tools (e.g., gh, glab, or MCP tools) specified by the CVS_TOOL environment variable to manage code, issues, and PRs.
howto.when_en: Triggered when Claude needs to perform version control operations such as commits, pushes, creating issues, or PRs.

say_en.text: Create a new GitHub issue titled 'Fix styling on login page'.
say_en.note: Claude will use gh or cvs_github tools to create the issue.

say_en.text: Commit and push the current branch changes to the remote repository.
say_en.note: Claude will use git or jj for local commit and push.
